title: Leab-Tui 3D — Traditional Xiangqi Trick-Taking Studio
description: A bilingual, interactive 3D studio for เลี๊ยบตุ่ย (Leab-Tui), the Thai trick-taking game played with the 32 tiles of a Chinese chess set. Vanilla HTML5, CSS3 and ES2022 JavaScript with Three.js r160 and serverless PeerJS/WebRTC multiplayer from pinned CDNs.

build.note: Wall clock from the OpenCode session record (time_created to the last measured token update), including the review gap between requests. The final state commit and push add a small amount.
build.includes: 1.4.x–1.6.0 P2P, chat, voice, approval, PIN and caps; 1.7–1.8 table zones, drag, showdown, piles, bid/redraw; 1.9.0–1.9.6 reveal/history comparisons, Chuan explanations, winner badges; 1.9.7–1.9.18 draft, random/seeded bots, full-circle results, guest rejoin, tablet reset/2D, update-safe tables, PWA full-screen, host reload recovery, late join, viewers, join pause, room-info copy and showdown legality; 1.9.19 2D shadows off, stage-fitted camera and iPad emulation. 1.9.20 HUD-safe hint toasts, selected-tile inspector and H hand controls. 1.9.21 iPad landscape panel rail restored. 1.9.22 turn-log sheet play-history link. 1.10.4 Invite, audience mode, watchers, action ACK, heartbeats, keepalive/turn timeout, seat-card reconnect, iPad hand fan and dock restore. 1.10.5 approval receipts, welcome ack/retry, join-status recovery. 1.10.6 tile size, autoplay, seat reclaim and state freshness. 1.10.7 binary transport, epoch/seq, state ACKs, action retries, four-human and lossy soak, fixed iPad viewport. 1.10.8 liveness-based seat takeover and host push-state.

verification.browserCheck: scripts/verify.mjs — 51 checks incl. iPad dealt-hand completeness, blind pick, tile size and autoplay
verification.multiplayer: scripts/net-check.mjs — ≈58 checks including a 4-human full-round soak, 10% loss/duplicate/100 ms delay soak, host push-state, host reload and seat reclaim
verification.privacy: guest own 8 real ids; other 24 ghost ids
verification.disconnect: guest tab closed → seat 1 became a bot, hand/score preserved
verification.screenshots: hero, Thai, rules, mobile, lobby, lobby-host, lobby-mobile, guest-play, iPad portrait, iPad landscape
verification.lateJoin: started guest queued and approved into a bot seat; live hand inherited
verification.viewer: seat -1, all hands ghosted, hand dock hidden, clean console
verification.joinPause: new guest rejected with suppressed; resume works
verification.copyRoomInfo: host Actions button + host chip title
verification.hostReload: same room code, trick preserved, guest reconnected
verification.showdownLegality: illegal pair explained; legal losing sets remain showable
verification.ipad: portrait and landscape: whole rim, no 2D shadows, Invite controls, C/M/A/i/H/L rail, hand fan without overlap
verification.invite: scripts/invite-check.mjs — 16 checks: solo → host, audio, popup, audience mode, promotion, resync, seat-card reconnect
verification.joinRecovery: welcome retried until welcome-ack; waiting guest polls status every 4 s; queued/viewer resync answered; invite sheet clears with a receipt
verification.displayTiles: four tile sizes (0.9 / 1.0 / 1.12 / 1.3) scale the local 3D hand and dock chips; hand row reflows inward at XL
verification.autoplay: toggle plays only the local seat in solo, host and guest roles; lead/follow/showdown/bid/draft covered
verification.seatReclaim: a same-name viewer is returned to an offline human seat; recovered seats free to bots after a 30 s grace
verification.autoRejoin: auto reconnect now retries every 1.2 s after a host reload instead of stopping at one attempt
verification.stateFreshness: client watchdog resyncs after 9 s without a snapshot and reconnects after 24 s
verification.transport: PeerJS binary serialisation (chunked) so late-round four-human snapshots stay under the JSON 16 KB ceiling
verification.ordering: host epoch + monotonic seq on every state/welcome; guests ignore stale, duplicate or previous-incarnation messages
verification.antiEntropy: per-seat state ACKs with targeted resend; 4 s full snapshot heartbeat; 9 s resync and 24 s reconnect watchdogs
verification.actions: actionId dedupe plus same-ID retry every 1.5 s (4 attempts) and a stale-snapshot gate
verification.silentSeats: closed or quiet human connections are swept to bots after 20–30 s; a seat and a viewer entry can no longer mask each other
verification.networkImpairment: ?netem=drop/dup/delay/jitter runs only in tests; 4 humans stay live at 10% loss
verification.touch: iOS fixed visual viewport, second-touchstart guard and pinch/gesture cancellation
verification.slowPlayers: a connected player is never bot-replaced for taking >30 s; only a closed or silent connection loses the seat
verification.blindPick: CSPRNG Fisher-Yates deal; 8 face-down tiles per seat, 32 unique, same seed produces different hands

releaseHistory.summary: Initial release: rules engine, four-seat 3D table, AI, bilingual coach, inspector, undo, audio, persistence and documentation.
Display settings: four interface text sizes and three themes (Mahogany, Jade Court, Midnight Lacquer) with matching UI and 3D table palettes.
Removed the distracting floating turn chevron; the active seat ring and TURN chip carry turn state.
Added Parchment and Daybreak bright themes with full CSS and 3D palettes; five-theme picker.
Added a bilingual pictorial rank-order quick reference with red/black Hanzi, names, rank numbers and tie rules.
Enlarged the rank-order sheet to near-full stage width with larger tiles, names and a two-column mobile layout.
Fixed the rank-sheet Hanzi size (44 px/36 px) and stacked the red/black medallions for table comparison.
Serverless host-authoritative WebRTC multiplayer: lobby, room codes, 2–4 humans, bot fill, per-seat redaction, seat-relative view, disconnect-to-bot and two-browser verification.

Launch prompt on every normal load with Resume match; required player names for host and guest; invite links ask the guest to confirm their name; dedicated Leave room with confirmation; host Start hidden after kickoff; compact mobile room chip; 13-check two-browser suite.
Host-routed text chat, full-mesh P2P voice, independent mic mute/deafen, remote audio elements, speaking pulse, chat/voice screenshots and 17-check two-browser suite.
Host approval queue, strong generated PIN with memory-only SHA-256 digest, Copy room info, abuse caps, voice allowlist, security docs and 21-check two-browser suite.
Copy invite + PIN, native Share, guest Paste with passcode extraction, 38 self-tests.
Version chip/reload, versioned assets, no-store update banner, diagnostics/probe, join retry diagnostics and mobile join intent restore.
Five-digit PIN, clearer Leave room button, 5-digit paste extraction and security documentation updated.
iPad landscape keyboard-safe join modal and high-contrast approval controls.
Prevent accidental backdrop dismissal of the Host/Join launch prompt.
Simplified Host a table: removed redundant Copy invite link and code-help label.
Friendlier launch menu, host/join panels, obvious Join audio, in-dialog EN/TH switch, theme-aware chat colours.
Automatic audio join on start/connect, with a persisted opt-out checkbox.
Unprefixed room numbers, big Reload version bar, throttled self-update.
Top-view default with a 3D toggle, and free hand arrangement by dragging.
Manual showdown choices, result banner with host duration, last-trick panel, segmented view switch, detailed pile cards.
Dancing 3D summary, host-gated next round with 5s auto-start, showdown button and HUD pointer fixes.
Allow showing a losing legal set at showdown.
Captured pile cards show the source player.
Trick history browser, host auto-next toggle, boot version guard.
Drag a tile onto the table to play it.
Table zones, double-click show, Turn/Now wording.
Deeper personal arrangement zone.
Capture visibility/grouping fixes, winner check, leave in top bar, Cancel turn.
Reveal result panel with a big Continue before the sweep.
Staged drag-to-play and the arrangement design record.
Chuan clarified as standard; in-app rules text updated.
Illustrated rules document with worked examples.
Chuan-aware result explanations and pile popup details.
Turn-Log-style reveal result panel.
Large winner badge on captured pile cards.
Experimental draft deal with host toggle and P2P relay.
Shared comparison popup for reveal results and turn history.
Table draft switch, logged bot picks and a large host PIN.
Random bot draft picks.
Seed reaches the draft; redraw deals a different hand.
Full-circle trick result for everyone; guest auto-rejoin.
Tablet reset-board shortcut and WebGL recovery.
2D pan/zoom with fixed orientation; launch-menu Draft toggle.
Update preserves the table: solo resume and guest reconnecting view.
Installable full-screen web app with icons and safe-area layout.
Late join, bot replacement, viewers and 30-minute join pause.
Show legal losing sets; explain illegal submissions.
Shadow-free 2D and iPad portrait/landscape table fitting with emulated checks.
iPad hint placement, inspector selection fallback and H hand controls.
Restore the C/M/A/i/H/L panel rail on iPad landscape.
Turn-log sheet exposes the shared play-history browser on iPad.
Invite from solo, audience queue, watchers, keepalive, resync and iPad hand fixes.
Approval receipts, welcome acknowledgement/retry and join-status recovery so approved guests never stall on the waiting screen.
Adjustable tile size, autoplay for the local seat, seat reclaim after a lost rejoin token and a state-freshness watchdog.
Launch menu simplification, tile size, dock autoplay, turn wording, binary transport, epoch/seq ordering, state ACKs, silent-seat sweep and a 4-human lossy soak.
Slow but connected players keep their seat; the host can push the latest snapshot to everyone.
Unique bot names and a You badge on the scoreboard so a human seat is never confused with a bot.
Clearer bid wording: what a pile is, how exact and missed bids score, and the last-bidder rule.
Remove the non-standard bid-piles scoring variant from the interface and docs; standard pile scoring only.
iPad deal reflows the local hand automatically so all eight tiles appear without pressing Tidy hand.
Remove the experimental draft picker; standard random face-down deal only.
Optional Blind pick house variant: crypto-shuffled eight-card deal, face-down, no open pool.
The hand dock opens by default; a player's H choice is remembered separately.
Blind pick is a face-down pool choice: pick two by position, values hidden until they join the hand.
Host-left is terminal with a manual Reconnect; tile size scales only the local hand.
Thai turn results name the Chinese tile and its Thai meaning; the turn-result dialog can auto-close in 5-30 s.
Rounds score by captured tiles against par eight, with no target and no match end.
Top-bar Join, autoplay holds while result sheets are open, New match removed.
Join hides once you are in a room.
The result-announcement seconds control is gone from the HUD.
Every player owns their turn-result pause; autoplay waits for their own sheet.
The host waits for its own turn-result sheet before the next trick starts.
The turn result closes when its auto-close countdown reaches zero.
Trick becomes Turn in code and docs; guests can leave from the iPad top bar; Chuan copy shows +24.

releaseNotes: 1.10.26 renames the round phase from Trick to Turn everywhere: the counter is state.turnNo, the acting seat stays state.turn, and old saves are adopted on load. iPad guests now get the Leave room pill in the top bar, compacted to an icon. Chuan copy now states the par-eight value (+24).
